description: This file defines a Telegram channel plugin for a larger chat application, including configuration, messaging, security, threading, outbound message handling, and integration with external APIs and modules.

methods.name: resolveTelegramProbe
methods.description: Resolves the probe function for Telegram, either from runtime or default module.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAuditCollector
methods.description: Resolves the audit collector function for Telegram.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAuditMembership
methods.description: Resolves the audit membership function for Telegram.

methods.name: resolveTelegramMonitor
methods.description: Resolves the monitor provider for Telegram.

methods.name: getOptionalTelegramRuntime
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current Telegram runtime, returns null if unavailable.

methods.name: resolveTelegramSend
methods.description: Resolves the function to send Telegram messages, considering dependencies and runtime.

methods.name: resolveTelegramTokenHelper
methods.description: Resolves the function to obtain Telegram tokens, from runtime or default.

methods.name: buildTelegramSendOptions
methods.description: Constructs options for sending Telegram messages based on parameters.

methods.name: sendTelegramOutbound
methods.description: Sends outbound Telegram messages with specified parameters.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAcpConversationId
methods.description: Normalizes a Telegram ACP conversation ID if it matches specific criteria.

methods.name: matchTelegramAcpConversation
methods.description: Matches a Telegram ACP conversation against a binding.

methods.name: shouldTreatTelegramRoutedTextAsVisible
methods.description: Determines if routed Telegram text should be treated as visible based on its kind.

methods.name: targetsMatchTelegramReplySuppression
methods.description: Checks if two Telegram targets match for reply suppression purposes.

methods.name: resolveTelegramCommandConversation
methods.description: Resolves a Telegram command conversation based on various parameters.

methods.name: resolveTelegramInboundConversation
methods.description: Resolves inbound Telegram conversation details from parameters.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Resolves the delivery target for a Telegram conversation.

methods.name: parseTelegramExplicitTarget
methods.description: Parses an explicit Telegram target string into structured data.

methods.name: shouldStripTelegramThreadFromAnnounceOrigin
methods.description: Determines if Telegram thread info should be stripped from an announce origin.

methods.name: buildTelegramBaseSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a base session key for Telegram outbound sessions.

methods.name: resolveTelegramOutboundSessionRoute
methods.description: Resolves the outbound session route for Telegram messages.
